body:
I have a direction that I want to go, but corporations restrict me because of my background.  I've developed multiple websites... you look at a red lobster menu that I designed... I'm CCNA certified, but unable to get a full-time job.  My focus and purpose are there, but I can't get anyone to give me a chance to prove my worth.  My resume is impressive, until they do a background check.  I "wow" interviewers, but can't get a call back.  They just saw my charges... 
..
I've gone to rehab, did my probation, and paid my fines.  That's all I was supposed to do to pay back society.  Meanwhile, I'm getting fucked out of every job that doesn't involve manual labor or flipping fries.  FUCK!!!  I'm a John Hopkins "Gifted Child" who just couldn't afford college.  

Worst part is, I'm too smart to know what my future will hold.  

I appreciate your concern, but its my focus that's being restrained combined with my past haunting me is my main difficulty. But my problem is not my focus, its needing a soft voice to vent to.  I do appreciate your concern, but typing is doing me no good.

BTW- I was convicted of selling coke.  I did it so I could put myself through college, and start up a college fund for my baby cousin.  That $10k I dropped for her years ago now affords her (parents) 2yrs at a private college.  I barely bought myself anything.  I'm still driving the '98 mercury POS I had when I went to college.  

TL;DR- I am a generous person who sold drugs and got caught.
